fact: e-GA reports the Tanzania Electronic Single Window System (TeSWS) was built in phases with TRA and TPA, 877 of 1,142 clearing agent firms using it, 459,671 customs declarations processed, and it exchanges data with TANCIS and regulators (TBS, TMDA, GCLA, TAEC).
title: Single Window: Mfumo unaoleta suluhu ya changamoto za uondoshaji wa shehena Bandarini
